posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I thought G.I. Bunker was the guy on "Ghostly Images" from the Realm of Discord, but that's not him on there.  That Bunker and the be-goggled Legacy fighting next to him look like they're probably one revision earlier than WWII, I'd guess, so WWI-era.

For both the WWII and WWI versions of Bunker, one thing stands out to me in the design of their suits - it must be irritating to not be able to move your head because it's attached by a hose to your chest...

posts.cooked:
It was also irritating not to have air conditioning - those suits can get hot!

There have certainly been a number of technological advancements to the Bunker since the mid 20th century, a fact for which Tyler Vance is most likely quite grateful :)

Even without the tube, I think GI Bunker would have a hard time looking around. As the glass on his chest is where I think his head is and is where he sees out of.
